[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]SMAPI - and requirements[/b]
[/list] ﻿ Make sure SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) and CP (Content Patcher) are downloaded and up to date!

[b]﻿2. Vampire Office[/b]
﻿ Install this mod!

[b]﻿3. Mod Folder[/b]
﻿ Unzip Vampire Office and place it into your mods folder! (It can be in a subfolder if you like to keep things organized.)
[b]
